templates.title: Document templates
templates.intro: Word and Excel templates and traceability maps that can be chosen when launching the documentation. Without a template, the documentation uses the default format.
templates.introGlobal: Templates available in all projects. Each project can add its own.
templates.limits: Word (.docx, .dotx): cover page, header, footer and styles; it needs the Title, Heading 1 to 3 and No Spacing styles, and its orientation is respected. Excel (.xlsx, .xltx): theme (colours and fonts), header and footer and page setup; no cover page or images in the header. No macros, embedded objects or external links. Traceability map (.toml, .json, up to 1 MB): links tables, views, routines and columns in the Markdown to code, documents and requirements; the syntax is checked on upload and every field when generating.

storage.title: Storage
storage.intro: Storage quota per user, retention of runs and files, and bulk load limits. Each setting starts from its UBW_* variable and applies without restarting: quota and limits immediately, and retention on the worker's next pass (every hour) or with “Apply now”.

help.user_quota_mb: Space for each user's runs and files; 0 = unlimited.
help.run_retention_days: Runs finished more than this many days ago are purged; 0 = never.
help.run_retention_per_project: The most recent ones in each project are kept; 0 = no maximum.
help.upload_retention_days: Files not used by any bulk load are deleted; 0 = never.
help.quota_purge: When users reach their quota, their oldest runs are purged (never those from the last hour or those used by a running run).
help.quota_purge_target_pct: Percentage of the quota the purge brings usage down to.
help.upload_max_mb: Up to 2048 MB. A file counts towards the user's quota.
help.upload_max_uncompressed_mb: Stops .xlsx files that take up much more space when uncompressed; also applies to templates.
help.bulk_max_rows: A file with more rows cannot be previewed or loaded.

storage.uploadsIntro: Limits for bulk load CSV and Excel files. A large CSV is read and loaded in blocks; an Excel file or a bulk load with a parallel plan is read whole into memory. Behind a reverse proxy, its request size limit (client_max_body_size in nginx) must be at least this; see the deployment guide.
storage.uploadsSaved: Limits saved: they apply to subsequent uploads and bulk loads.
storage.willReset: It will return to the default value when saved.
storage.applyRequested: The worker will apply retention and the purge in a few seconds.
storage.confirmPurge: With these settings, the next pass will purge {{runs}} runs ({{runBytes}}) and {{uploads}} files ({{uploadBytes}}) from {{users}} users. Runs keep their history (run.json), but their files are deleted.
storage.confirmNothing: With these settings nothing will be purged now.

mine.title: My storage
mine.unlimited: You are using {{used}}; your account has no storage limit.
mine.nearTitle: You are running out of space
mine.nearBody: When you reach your quota you will not be able to launch runs or upload files. Free up space by purging old runs from their detail page or deleting files in the Bulk load tab of your projects.
mine.purgeBody: When you reach your quota, your oldest finished runs are purged until usage drops to {{pct}} %. Never those from the last hour or those used by a running run.
